concepts.gloss_en: God as 'the Place of the world' — He is the place of the world, the world is not His place

reason_for_human: All four occurrences carry identical vocalization (מְקוֹמוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם) and identical meaning — the classic epithet of God as the Place of the world. 'הוא מקומו של עולם' is simply the same phrase with the preceding pronoun 'הוא' (He is...); it is not a distinct concept but an inflectional/syntactic variant. The lm2:83 usage ties it to עיקר המקום/מקום, still the same divine-Place idea.
